bull.b: Sustained multi-quarter revenue acceleration reflects real adoption and expanding treatment center footprint, improving top-line predictability. A durable revenue ramp strengthens commercial infrastructure, supports reinvestment in manufacturing and market access, and reduces sole reliance on milestone funding.

bull.t: First positive gross profit and improving unit economics
bull.b: Achieving positive gross profit signals scalable unit economics as volumes rise. Management's 65%–70% peak ALL gross margin target and announced $15M annualized savings indicate durable margin upside from operational improvements and higher throughput, which supports long-term profitability at the product level.

bull.t: Robust pipeline and supportive real‑world efficacy
bull.b: Compelling real-world and clinical signals underpin durable demand and label expansion potential. High efficacy and favorable safety outside trials increase physician confidence, facilitate reimbursement discussions, and sustain long-term addressable-market growth across hematology and autoimmune indications.

bear.b: Deep negative operating and free cash flow imply ongoing reliance on external financing to fund operations and development. Persistent burn elevates dilution and covenant risk, constrains flexibility for commercial investment, and forces prioritization of programs over the next 12–24 months.

bear.t: Sustained company-level losses and weak profitability
bear.b: Despite product-level progress, company-level margins remain deeply negative, driven by high SG&A and legacy R&D. Continued heavy losses limit retained-capital accumulation and require disciplined execution to convert product-level margins into company profitability, prolonging financing dependence.

Successful tech transfer and higher-volume manufacturing are critical for expansion into MS and other indications. Execution failure or delays would raise per-unit costs, hinder margin targets, and slow international rollouts, making commercial and profitability projections vulnerable over the medium term.
